facts.fact: Téla Nón reports that a workshop on information security was held in the capital with public administration staff taking part, and the national director of public administration says staff handling the planned civil-service personnel database must be trained.
facts.system: Information security workshop for public administration staff

facts.fact: Téla Nón reports that the national personal data protection agency is acting, developing cybersecurity applications and internal systems for the state and helping to secure public administration information.
facts.system: Agência nacional de proteção de dados pessoais

systems.system: Agência nacional de proteção de dados pessoais
